hebrewText: עָלָי/ו֙ יִשְׁאֲג֣וּ כְפִרִ֔ים נָתְנ֖וּ קוֹלָ֑/ם וַ/יָּשִׁ֤יתוּ אַרְצ/וֹ֙ לְ/שַׁמָּ֔ה עָרָ֥י/ו נצתה נִצְּת֖וּ מִ/בְּלִ֥י יֹשֵֽׁב

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.enLiteralWord: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.explanation: a village ; also a young lion
tokens.explanationEn: a village ; also a young lion

tokens.bdb: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
tokens.kjv: add, apply, appoint, ascribe, assign, [idiom] avenge, [idiom] be (healed), bestow, bring (forth, hither), cast, cause, charge, come, commit, consider, count, [phrase] cry, deliver (up), direct, distribute, do, [idiom] doubtless, [idiom] without fail, fasten, frame, [idiom] get, give (forth, over, up), grant, hang (up), [idiom] have, [idiom] indeed, lay (unto charge, up), (give) leave, lend, let (out), [phrase] lie, lift up, make, [phrase] O that, occupy, offer, ordain, pay, perform, place, pour, print, [idiom] pull, put (forth), recompense, render, requite, restore, send (out), set (forth), shew, shoot forth (up), [phrase] sing, [phrase] slander, strike, (sub-) mit, suffer, [idiom] surely, [idiom] take, thrust, trade, turn, utter, [phrase] weep, [phrase] willingly, [phrase] withdraw, [phrase] would (to) God, yield.
tokens.explanation: natan — dar, entregar, conceder, pôr, colocar

tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ([phrase] out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, [phrase] hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, [phrase] sing, sound, [phrase] spark, thunder(-ing), voice, [phrase] yell.

tokens.bdb: to place (in a very wide application)
tokens.kjv: apply, appoint, array, bring, consider, lay (up), let alone, [idiom] look, make, mark, put (on), [phrase] regard, set, shew, be stayed, [idiom] take.

tokens.bdb: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] common, country, earth, field, ground, land, [idiom] natins, way, [phrase] wilderness, world.
tokens.explanation: eretz — terra, solo, país, região, toda a terra

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.bdb: to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate
tokens.kjv: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to burn or set on fire; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to burn or set on fire; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to burn or set on fire; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to burn or set on fire; figuratively

tokens.bdb: to burn or set on fire; figuratively, to desolate
tokens.kjv: burn (up), be desolate, set (on) fire (fire), kindle.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to burn or set on fire; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to burn or set on fire; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to burn or set on fire; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to burn or set on fire; figuratively

tokens.bdb: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
tokens.kjv: corruption, ig(norantly), for lack of, where no...is, so that no, none, not, un(awares), without.

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.
